info.title: Queue OpenAPI for minimax/h3-max/recast
info.description: H3 Max Recast replaces the main people in a source video with people from reference photos, tracking each person across shots. Provide a video and one photo per new person, with an optional prompt to specify who becomes whom or which details to keep or change. The model aims to preserve the original motion, gestures, camera, shot timing, and soundtrack. Supports up to four reference photos and videos up to 30 seconds, with individual shots no longer than 15 seconds, at 768p or 1080p.

reference_image_urls.title: Reference Image URLs
reference_image_urls.description: One photo per new person. By default they replace the main people in the video from left to right, each in every shot they appear in.

enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker
enable_safety_checker.description: Authorized callers may set false to request relaxed screening.

enhance_realism.title: Enhance Realism
enhance_realism.description: More natural skin textures and better blending of the new people into the scene. Off unless set.

video_url.title: Video URL
video_url.description: The source video, 5 to 30 seconds long, with no single shot longer than 15 seconds.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Random seed. Leave empty for a random one.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Optional: who becomes whom, or what else to keep or change.

video.description: The recast video, with the source sound.

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.
